description:
Find the products and services in the company's catalog.

Look a line up here before typing it into issue_invoice: when it
is saved, pass its id as item_id and the description, price and
fiscal codes come from the catalog. Most recently used first.
Read-only.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

inactive.description: List the deactivated items instead of the active ones.

kind.description: product for goods, service for services.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

search.description: Part of the description, code or external reference; digits also match the NCM and GTIN.

name: list_items

ItemRecord.description: One product or service the company sells, kept in its catalog.

id.description: Pass it as item_id to issue_invoice or save_item.

outputSchema.description: A page of the company's catalog.

total.description: How many match, not how many are here.
